notes.title: Space Saga is now available!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Pilots,[/b][/p][p]First of all, we want to sincerely apologize for the delay in Space Saga’s launch. Some of our team members faced unexpected personal challenges, and with such a small crew, it inevitably impacted our development process.[/p][p]We also want to thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your patience and support. This is our very first release, and we’ve made our fair share of mistakes along the way — but we’re learning fast, and we’re committed to improving every step of the journey.[/p][p]During the Festival demo, we read every piece of feedback you sent. Your reports, bug finds, and creative suggestions have been invaluable. We might not always respond instantly, but know that we’re always listening and taking notes.[/p][p]Now, the wait is over. [b]Space Saga is opening its galaxy warp gates, and you are welcome to begin conquering your own corner of the stars.[/b][/p][p]Stay tuned — this is just the beginning.
Our immediate plans are to:[/p][list][*][p]Gather and review your feedback[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix the issues found[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Continue polishing the core gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Add more features and expand the universe[/p][/*][*][p]Move towards the full release[/p][/*][/list][p]As a small team that became even smaller by the end of development, every milestone we’ve reached has been thanks to your encouragement. Your [b]support, faith, and feedback[/b] are the most valuable assets we have. If you want to see Space Saga evolve, know that you are an essential part of that journey.[/p][p]From our crew to yours — thank you, Pilots. See you among the stars.[/p]

notes.title: Game Release moved to June 30
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we have an important update. We really wanted to launch the game on time, but we know we can make it better. And we don’t want to release something unfinished.

We’re a small team, putting our hearts into this project. So, we made a tough but right decision: the release is moving to June 30.

We’ll use this time to polish, refine, and improve the game.

Thank you for your patience and support — it means the world to us!

Stay tuned, exciting things are coming! 

We can’t wait to share what we’ve been working on — trust us, it’ll be worth it!

notes.title: Space Saga: cosmic horizons update
notes.notes:
Fellow spacefarers,
We’re thrilled to bring you a fresh wave of updates to Space Saga. Our team has been hard at work to enhance your experience, making the vast universe of Space Saga more immersive, challenging, and, of course, fun!

[h2]What’s we’ve achieved:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]World Generation:[/b] the universe just got a lot more interesting! We’ve improved the world generation system, introducing biomes to sectors. Now, the environment of each sector will influence the resources and challenges you encounter, making every journey into a unique adventure.
[*] [b]Consumable Items:[/b] your ship is your lifeline, and we’ve introduced consumable items to help you keep it in top shape. Whether you need to boost your ship’s capabilities or fortify your territory, these items will give you the edge you need in the vastness of space. Deployable battle platforms! Defend your territories by placing autonomous auto-turrets in space.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/a122d1b4461ea0236b9ad306c38a673a88821899.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/a959b47396fd6ec1ece3f04bb4dda21dccc67a95.png[/img]
[*] [b]Energy System:[/b] quickly adapt to the situation by redistributing energy as needed. Start by powering up weapons to deal damage to the enemy. If the opponent gains the upper hand, switch to shields to buy time for regrouping or retreat. In a prolonged fight, shift energy to engines for better maneuvering or a tactical retreat.
[previewyoutube=GPLhXzFPDBc;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] [b]Protectors Fleets:[/b] space stations and outposts are now guarded by powerful fleets. Any hostile actions against them will trigger an immediate response, with Protector fleets arriving via hyperjump in seconds.
[*] [b]Global Map:[/b] navigate the galaxy like never before with our new Global Map. While some features are still in development, you can already check out the ongoing conflicts between factions and hyperjump to key locations. Stay tuned for more updates, including faction management features.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/e3967d15600bd07aac61957e0cd3ed7da6bf1c45.png[/img]

[*] [b]New Pirate Faction:[/b] introducing a new threat to the cosmos: the Pirates! Known for their speed, cunning, and ruthlessness, this new faction specializes in robberies, caravan attacks, and quick strikes. They are a force to be reckoned with.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/e9c348a417d5b65ec9e46f708a52737bd675de3b.png[/img]

[*] [b]New Modules:[/b] customize your ship further with a variety of new modules, including two brand-new sets, offering even more ways to tailor your experience and dominate the stars.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/28f06ecf5bf14e4ec0c201462a985812be036a01.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/790d94db1318155effcd5fd12df66e7618f0bb39.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/f3e96044e6b383883a52e6c98a9065bdcff02ccc.png[/img]

[*] [b]Partial Gamepad Support:[/b] we’re expanding the ways you can enjoy Space Saga.
[*] [b]AI Improvements:[/b] our continuous efforts to enhance the AI have paid off. Fleets and bots are now smarter and more responsive, providing you with a more challenging and realistic space adventure.
[*] [b]Items:[/b] we’ve given our in-game items a visual overhaul with new, fancy icons. Plus, we’re adding new resources and weapons to keep your inventory full of exciting options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/0e08279f57a1b5be3ba6086988d9db1cad644be3.png[/img]

[*] [b]UI Enhancements:[/b] we’ve made several improvements to the UI, including new filters, better interactions, and a more intuitive design.
[*] [b]Ship Controls:[/b] experience the thrill of space combat with improved ship controls. We’ve refined the logic and physics behind the controls to ensure every maneuver feels just right.
[*] [b]Sound Updates:[/b] Space Saga now features a richer soundscape with new music tracks for both exploration and combat.
[/list]

Keep exploring, stay vigilant, and may the stars guide you!

notes.title: Space Saga: past achievements and future plans
notes.notes:
Space Saga launches you into a captivating universe from the start. As intrepid spacefarers, you explore uncharted territories, engage in epic battles, and forge alliances, immersing themselves in a richly detailed storyline.

[h2]What We've Achieved:[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fleets AI: we have implemented AI in fleets. These fleets have become smarter and more adaptive, capable of autonomously gathering resources, engaging in strategic battles, and making crucial decisions to ensure their survival in the harsh environment of space.

[*]Global Map Generation: the introduction of a dynamically generated global map adds depth and realism to the game. You will be able to explore a vast, ever-changing universe. With each new journey, the galaxy unfolds in unpredictable ways, offering endless opportunities for discovery and adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/6a1dc329512e3fd16cbdca2e29edfb7881277114.png[/img]

[*]New Ships — Loopsians: we are constantly expanding our arsenal of spacecraft, offering you a choice. From sleek fighters to the new lineup - Loopsians. Each new addition brings unique capabilities and customization options, allowing players to tailor their fleet to their playstyle and strategic objectives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/651a53fcd11043c12b36b5c8c2c9be901bb8b512.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]What's Coming in May:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Crafting: you will be able to use your accumulated resources to create new, upgrade existing equipment, and customize your ships to improve their performance in battle. This addition promises to deepen the gaming experience and give you the opportunity to chart your own path among the stars.

[*]Global Economy (Work in Progress): this ambitious feature aims to simulate the complex interplay of trade, commerce, and diplomacy, allowing you to influence markets, establish trade routes, and shape the economic landscape of the Space Saga universe.
[/list]

Coming soon, we will be unveiling updates regarding our future global plans. We continue to develop the game, working on gameplay, rich narrative, and other features. As the universe expands, you will embark on an unforgettable journey through the stars.

notes.title: Space Saga: past achievements and future plans
notes.notes:
Hello, space travelers!

We are excited to present to you the latest updates in our game, Space Saga, as well as share our plans for the future. Here you will find an overview of what has already been done and what we are preparing for you.

[h2]What We’ve Achieved:
[/h2]

[list]
[*] Trading System: Now you can enjoy a variety of goods that can be bought or sold. Immerse yourself in the world of space economy and become a successful trader.

[*] Mining System: Embark on mining expeditions, equipping your ship with special lasers to extract valuable resources. You can personally engage in mining or assign this task to your fleet ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/2ec5eeacda01db2a7e76b9f8cf85e706e6901439.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/7ea383e62c5a5cf50e56b71f8849e9d39f7ea75a.png[/img]

[*] Photon Disintegrator: the new weapon in your arsenal. This cutting-edge weapon possesses unparalleled destructive power, capable of obliterating even the most formidable foes with its concentrated energy beams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/e79878bf7bd68018187ef832e53864292068f554.png[/img]

[*] Fleets and Artificial Intelligence: We are constantly improving the behavior of enemies and fleets. Now the fleet can also engage in mining, resource gathering, and selling, making it even more versatile.

[*] Visual Enhancements: We have significantly improved post-processing and some visual elements to make your space adventure even more captivating. We are also constantly working on updates to the user interface to make it more convenient and attractive.

[*] Mining Laser: Equip your ship with the latest in mining technology, boasting precision and power to efficiently extract resources.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/71e92035496035cb044f8f7db8bdadce5439b3ff.png[/img]

[h2]What’s coming in March:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Diplomacy: We plan to implement a diplomacy system that will allow you to interact with other factions and states in the cosmic world.

[*] Factions: Exciting adventures await you in the world of various factions, each with its own unique traits and goals.

[*] Global Economy: Get ready to immerse yourself in the complex world of economics, where your decisions will affect the global market state.
[/list]

Join us in Space Saga and embark on thrilling adventures across the boundless expanse of space. The future of our game is in your hands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/84f1ea841e4c7572f59d4efe24e2b104b5308691.png[/img]

notes.title: Space Saga: past achievements and future plans
notes.notes:
Hello, space adventurers! We are excited to present to you the fresh winds of change in the world of Space Saga, which we enthusiastically introduced throughout October and November. Additionally, we're sharing what you can expect in December and January.

[b][h3]What We’ve Achieved:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] [i] Module System:[/i] Now you can customize your ship to your liking, changing weaponry, shield generators, and other ship components to achieve your goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/af7feee58de4f5540941a2f6ab30a235e7163b60.png[/img]

[*] [i] New Ship Line – Astralith:[/i] Introducing a high-tech faction with robust shields and energy weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/9c98096e74cede3f15ef92f1e6fa7cb2d3f16c5e.png[/img]

A bit about factions – various factions in Space Saga will have unique ships and modules that characterize their gameplay style. Currently, two ship lines are implemented: Imperial – a faction with durable ships focusing on missile installations, and Astralith, as mentioned above. More details about factions and their features will be revealed in upcoming updates.

[*] [i] First UI Version for the Module System and More:[/i]  Expect more convenient and interface changes to make your space adventure even more captivating.

[*] [i] Contracts:[/i]  We have implemented the foundational functionality for the contract system. Accept contracts from representatives of various factions and receive rewards for your efforts.
[/list]

[b][h3]What’s coming in January:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] [i] Mining System:[/i] Unleash your exploratory tendencies! We're introducing a mining system that allows you to extract valuable resources from asteroids. From rare minerals to building materials, exciting opportunities for resource management and economic growth await.

[*] [i] Trading System:[/i] Space Saga is expanding its economy! We're implementing a trading system that enables you to buy, sell, and exchange resources. Engage in interstellar commerce, establish trade routes, and watch your fortune grow.

[*] [i] Fleets:[/i] We will expand the functionality of fleets and improve the AI ​​of fleets. Get ready for new levels of strategy with the introduction of fleets, expanding your capabilities in the battle for the galaxy!

[*] [i] Contracts:[/i] We will actively develop the contract system, introducing additional options and improving interactions.
[/list]

Don't miss the chance to be part of this captivating journey! Stay tuned for updates, and incredible discoveries and exciting adventures await you in the boundless cosmos of Space Saga. Get ready for new horizons, captains!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44068126/c58b5e41b7d6b0df22e7b285ac07a274c6923a8d.png[/img]

notes.title: Space Saga: past achievements and December plans
notes.notes:
In the ever-evolving world of Space Saga, our team has been hard at work to create an engaging gaming experience.

Here's a brief overview of what we've accomplished and what awaits us in December.

[h3][b]What We've Achieved:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [i]Space Objects:[/i] We have designed and implemented various space objects, including ships, asteroids, space stations and loot, all to enrich your in-game journey.
[*] [i]AI:[/i] We have successfully implemented basic battles involving bots capable of direct shooting. In addition, we have also integrated Fleet AI, allowing us to create fleets of various factions responsible for patrolling their territories. These enhancements have significantly enriched the gaming experience, and we are continuing to improve the AI, making it more advanced!
[*] [i]Tutorial: [/i]Recognizing the importance of a seamless introduction, we introduced an epic battle intro and context-based training guided by an AI assistant.
[*] [i]Localization: [/i]We expanded our audience by localizing the game, allowing players from different countries to enjoy Space Saga in their native languages: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Russian and Turkish.
[*] [i]Factions:[/i] We have successfully implemented the core faction feature, which is a significant milestone in game development. This feature will definitely be further refined in future updates!
[*] [i]Combat Core:[/i] We've developed a robust weapon system that introduces various types of weaponry, giving you more strategic options in battle. Now, you can wield different kinds of arms, each with its own unique capabilities, and inflict damage on objects within the game world. Prepare for more engaging and dynamic space battles!
[*] [i]UI:[/i] We've introduced an in-game HUD to provide you with crucial information at a glance. Additionally, we've made improvements to the draft document, streamlining the way you interact with the game's features and resources.
[*] [i]Sectors:[/i] We have divided the cosmos into distinct sectors, each of which will have its own characteristics, challenges, and opportunities. Each sector will feature unique content and diverse gameplay elements. Space exploration has become even more intriguing! 
[*] [i]Hyperjumps![/i]
[/list]
[h3][b]What's coming in December:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [i]Modules: [/i]Get ready to customize your spaceship like never before! We present a wide range of modules that will allow you to equip your ship with various functions and improvements. These top modules allow you to adapt to your unique playstyle with endless possibilities for strategic customization.
[*][i] Asteroid Belts:[/i] Venture into the heart of space to uncover valuable resources! Our new asteroid belts feature will revolve around resource extraction. You will have the opportunity to mine these celestial bodies for precious minerals. Navigate the treacherous terrain of asteroid belts, manage your mining operations, and build your fortune in the depths of space.
[*] [i]Mining System: [/i]Unleash your inner prospector! In the upcoming update, we're introducing a mining system that allows you to extract valuable resources from asteroids. Whether you're seeking rare minerals or building materials, this new feature will open up exciting possibilities for resource management and economic growth.
[*] [i]Trading System:[/i] Space Saga is expanding its economy! We're adding a trading system that will enable players to buy, sell, and exchange resources. Engage in interstellar commerce, establish trade routes, and watch your fortune grow.
[*] [i]More UI Enchantments![/i]
[*] [i]Contracts: [/i]Get ready for a new gameplay addiction with contract making. The contract system will allow you to complete various missions and tasks in the game universe. Whether it's delivering cargo or performing daring rescue missions, Contracts will provide cool challenges and rewarding opportunities for everyone!
[/list]

Space Saga is an ever-expanding universe, and we're delighted to have you on this journey with us.

Stay tuned for updates, and may your cosmic adventures be truly epic!
